name: Fantasy Travelers
source:
One day you meet a woman. She says she wants to go to a town. You have never heard the town before. According to her, going to the town requires magic items which will lead to the town. To help her go to the town, you decide to collect items along with her.

Each item has independent and unique magical power, such as teleportation, going through a wall, knowing the inner thoughts of other people. The more items you gain, the more magical powers you can use. During the journey you will obtain many items. Each time you gain an item, you will gain a new magical power and you will be able to do what you could not do before.

In the journey, you will obtain an item with which you can talk with animals. In this game, you are given many options to choose from, and your choices make an impact on the plot. You can help animals who have wishes, or you can have a quarrel with them. Your choices matter!

In the course of the journey, you will encounter many people and develop relationship with them. They will provide a variety of information and you will learn a lot from them. In this game, you will visit many unique spots, meet various people who will assist you. The items you will collect will lead you to the town. The game will surely give you an outstanding experience.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1853737400/fantasy-travelers-visual-novel/]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
某天，你遇见了一名女子。她说，自己想前往一座你从未听说过的小镇。据她所言，要抵达那里，需要借助能够指引道路的魔法道具。为了帮助她前往小镇，你决定与她一起收集这些道具。

每件道具都拥有独特的魔力，例如瞬间移动、穿越墙壁，或是读取他人的内心想法。获得的道具越多，能使用的魔法也越多。旅途中，你将得到许多道具。每得到一件，就会获得一种新的魔力，做到过去做不到的事。

你还会在旅途中获得能与动物交谈的道具。游戏提供许多选项，你的选择将影响剧情。你可以帮助心怀愿望的动物，也可以与它们争吵。每一个选择都很重要！

一路上，你将邂逅许多人，与他们建立关系。他们会提供各种信息，让你学到许多事情。你将造访独特的地点，遇见愿意相助的人们，而收集到的道具，会指引你抵达那座小镇。本作将带给你非同寻常的体验。

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1853737400/fantasy-travelers-visual-novel/]Kickstarter[/url]]
